verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AI drafting answers to inbound customer security questionnaires from the company's own controls and knowledge base. The closest item, Comply AI extracting answers from vendor SOC 2 reports, is the opposite workflow: it reviews third-party vendors rather than answering prospects' questionnaires. The Trust Center offers document self-serve and request approval, but no AI questionnaire answering, and the other Comply AI items cover policies, risk and SSPs rather than questionnaires.
